underwritingReview.underwriterComment: Document fails basic integrity checks: debtor company, invoice number, and industry are placeholder values ('e'), so the invoice's identity and the obligor cannot be established. Internal contradiction between stated 60-day payment terms and the 27-day invoice-to-due-date span (2026-09-03 to 2026-09-30) undermines validity. Dispute status is UNKNOWN and no PO, delivery, or acceptance evidence exists. The MVP reference dataset is explicitly fabricated and provides no verified debtor credit evidence; no debtor match is even possible. The thin 5.97% APY offers no compensation for these severe gaps. Decline.
keyRisks: Debtor company, invoice number, and industry are placeholder values ('e') — invoice identity and obligor cannot be established, suggesting an invalid or incomplete document
Contradiction between stated paymentTermsDays (60) and actual invoice-to-due-date span (27 days) casts doubt on document accuracy
Dispute status UNKNOWN — no confirmation the invoice is undisputed or free of dilution risk
No purchase order, contract, delivery, or acceptance reference linking the invoice to an acknowledged obligation
Debtor cannot be matched to any reference record; MVP reference data is explicitly fabricated sample data and is not verified borrower evidence
60-day return period extends well past the due date with no payer history supporting expected collection timing
5.97% APY is inadequate compensation for severe evidence and collectability uncertainty
missingEvidence: Valid debtor legal name and identity verification
Authentic invoice number and industry classification
Consistent payment terms reconciled with invoice and due dates
Purchase order or contract reference evidencing an accepted obligation
Proof of invoice delivery and acceptance by the debtor
Confirmed dispute status and dilution/credit-memo history
Verified debtor credit or payment history (supplied reference data is fabricated sample only)
Recourse, security, and concentration terms for the transaction
